title: Design meets code #ai #design #figma
description:
A new shift is happening at the intersection of design and development.

Anthropic and Figma are enabling a more connected workflow.

What’s changing:

— take a live website
— convert it into an editable design inside Figma
— keep the same structure and layout

Then:

— redesign and collaborate
— push updates back into the code

The key shift:

From separate processes → to one continuous loop

Before:

— design → handoff → development → rebuild

Now:

— design and code (connected in real time)

Why it matters:

— faster iteration
— fewer errors
— better collaboration between teams

Key insight:

The future isn’t about design or development separately—
it’s about merging them into one system.

#ai #design #figma
#webdev #tools #workflow #productivity #innovation #future #shorts
